name: Thermal / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A forceful flame bloom rolling into rough sustained combustion, then slowing ember pops and a charred physical crunch. Hot rushing air and gritty crackles. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
